simple.meaning: קׇרְבָּן (qorbân) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “something brought near the altar, i.e. a sacrificial present.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 82 times across Leviticus, Numbers, Nehemiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Leviticus 1:2. Its contexts include flock, offering, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קׇרְבָּן (H7133).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קׇרְבָּן (qorbân) / H7133 is traced through Leviticus 1:2, Leviticus 1:3, Leviticus 1:10, Leviticus 1:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H7133. qorban קָרְבָּן 80 noun masculine Lev 6:13 offering, oblation (Assyrian kurbannu , id., apparently always with כ Dl HWB 351 ); — absolute ׳ק 1:2 +; construct קָרְבַּן 2:1 +; Sf. קָרְבָּנִי Num 28:2 plural suffix קָרְבְּנֵיהֶם Lev 7:38 ; — offering, oblation , General term for all kinds of offering (only Ezekiel Leviticus Numbers [H P]): animal 1:2-3 , 10 +, vegetable 2:1 (twice in verse); 2:5 +, articles of gold Num 31:50 , silver 7:13 +, etc., as accusative of congnate meaning with verb after הִקְרִיב Lev 1:2 (twice in verse); 3:14 ; Num 6:14 + (see √ Hiph`il 2 b (5)); cstr ׳ק מִנְחָה Lev 2:1 , 4 , 13 ׳ק רֵאשִׁית 2:12 ׳ק אִשֶּׁה 22:27 ; ׳ק ׳י Num 9:7 , 13 (compareNumbers 31:50). [ קֻרְבָּן ] noun [masculine] offering ; — construct הָעֵצִים קֻרְבַּן wood-offering for second temple Neh 10:35 ; 13:31 . II. קרב (√ of following; compare Assyrian kirbu , midst ; Late Hebrew [ קֶרֶב ] plural entrails (rare); MI 23, 24 בקרב in the midst of the city; perhaps also Arabic heart ).
